theme: 教材字彙・進階 650–750 第 46 群

items.colloc: sudden change 突然的變化 | sudden increase 突然增加
items.distinct: abrupt 突然且粗魯的 | unexpected 未預料到的
ex: A sudden drop in sales caused concern.
銷售額突然下滑引起了擔憂。
We had to make a sudden decision.
我們必須做出一個突然的決定。
The sudden rain delayed the construction work.
突如其來的雨延誤了工程進度。

items.pos: v. 旅行；行進 | n. 旅行
items.colloc: travel expenses 差旅費 | travel agent 旅行社代理人
items.distinct: trip 短途旅行 | journey 長途旅行
ex: She travels frequently for business meetings.
她經常為了商務會議出差。
Please submit your travel expenses report.
請提交您的差旅費報銷單。
Global travel has become easier these days.
如今全球旅遊變得更加容易了。

items.colloc: unique opportunity 絕佳機會 | unique feature 獨特功能
items.distinct: special 特別的 | rare 罕見的
ex: This software offers a unique solution.
這套軟體提供了獨特的解決方案。
The brand has a unique marketing strategy.
該品牌擁有獨特的行銷策略。
It is a unique chance to expand globally.
這是一個向全球擴張的絕佳機會。

items.colloc: visitor center 遊客中心 | registered visitor 已登記訪客
items.distinct: guest 賓客 | tourist 觀光客
ex: All visitors must sign in at reception.
所有訪客必須在接待處簽到。
The visitor center provides helpful brochures.
遊客中心提供實用的手冊。
Many visitors attended the trade exhibition.
許多參觀者出席了貿易展覽。

items.pos: n. 展出；放映 | v. 表現（show的現在分詞）
items.colloc: strong showing 強勢表現 | private showing 私人展出
items.distinct: exhibition 展覽會 | display 陳列
ex: The company had a strong market showing.
公司在市場上有強勢的表現。
We arranged a private showing for investors.
我們為投資者安排了私人展出。
His presentation was a showing of true talent.
他的簡報展現了真正的才華。

items.pos: adv. 不同地；以不同方式
items.colloc: think differently 換個角度思考 | treat differently 不同對待
items.distinct: distinctly 明顯地 | otherwise 其他地
ex: We need to approach this task differently.
我們需要以不同的方式處理這項任務。
Customers often react differently to price hikes.
客戶對漲價的反應往往不同。
They handle client complaints quite differently.
他們處理客戶投訴的方式相當不同。

items.colloc: arrive at 到達某處 | arrive in 到達（城市/國家）
items.distinct: reach 到達 | get to 抵達
ex: The shipment should arrive by tomorrow morning.
貨物應該會在明天早上前抵達。
Please arrive at the office before nine.
請在九點前抵達辦公室。
We arrived in Tokyo for the conference.
我們抵達東京參加研討會。

items.pos: n. 帳單；法案 | v. 開帳單
items.colloc: utility bill 水電費帳單 | pay the bill 付帳
items.distinct: invoice 發票 | receipt 收據
ex: Please pay your utility bill on time.
請準時支付您的水電費帳單。
The company will bill us next week.
公司下週會寄帳單給我們。
The new bill will impact small businesses.
這項新法案將影響小型企業。

items.colloc: city center 市中心 | city council 市議會
items.distinct: town 城鎮 | downtown 市中心區
ex: The head office is located in the city.
總部設在市中心。
Many city officials attended the event.
許多城市官員參加了這次活動。
We are expanding into several major cities.
我們正在擴展到幾個主要城市。

items.colloc: sales clerk 店員 | office clerk 辦事員
items.distinct: receptionist 接待員 | assistant 助理
ex: The store clerk offered excellent service.
那位店員提供了優質的服務。
An office clerk processed the documents.
一位辦事員處理了那些文件。
Ask the clerk for the return policy.
向店員詢問退貨政策。

items.pos: n. 硬幣 | v. 創造（新詞）
items.colloc: gold coin 金幣 | coin operated 投幣式的
items.distinct: currency 貨幣 | cash 現金
ex: The machine does not accept small coins.
這台機器不接受小額硬幣。
They coined a new term for the product.
他們為該產品創造了一個新詞。
You need coins to use the locker.
你需要硬幣才能使用寄物櫃。

items.pos: n. 混凝土 | adj. 具體的；實在的
items.colloc: concrete evidence 具體證據 | concrete wall 混凝土牆
items.distinct: specific 明確的 | tangible 有形的
ex: We need a concrete plan by Friday.
我們週五前需要一個具體的計畫。
The building is made of reinforced concrete.
這棟建築是由鋼筋混凝土建造的。
Do you have concrete proof of the error?
你有錯誤的具體證據嗎？

items.pos: n. 洋裝 | v. 穿著
items.colloc: dress code 服裝規定 | dress up 打扮
items.distinct: wear 穿著（狀態）| put on 穿上（動作）
ex: Employees should follow the dress code.
員工應遵守服裝規定。
Please dress professionally for the interview.
面試請穿著專業。
She wore a formal dress to the gala.
她穿了一件正式禮服參加晚宴。

items.colloc: earn a living 謀生 | earn interest 賺取利息
items.distinct: gain 獲得 | win 贏得（比賽/獎項）
ex: He works hard to earn a salary.
他努力工作以賺取薪水。
The project earned the team high praise.
該專案為團隊贏得了高度讚揚。
Saving accounts help you earn interest.
儲蓄帳戶能幫助你賺取利息。

items.colloc: global economy 全球經濟 | market economy 市場經濟
items.distinct: economic 經濟上的 | economical 節約的
ex: The global economy is showing recovery signs.
全球經濟正顯示出復甦跡象。
High inflation affects the national economy.
高通膨影響著國民經濟。
We chose an economical business travel plan.
我們選擇了一個經濟實惠的差旅計畫。

items.colloc: employ staff 僱用員工 | employ strategies 運用策略
items.distinct: hire 僱用 | utilize 利用
ex: The firm plans to employ more specialists.
該公司計畫僱用更多專家。
They employ various methods to save time.
他們運用多種方法來節省時間。
The restaurant currently employs twenty staff.
這家餐廳目前僱用了二十名員工。

items.colloc: make an exception 做個例外 | with the exception of 除了...之外
items.distinct: exclusion 排除 | deviation 偏差
ex: No exceptions will be made to this rule.
此項規定不會有任何例外。
Everyone attended, with the exception of one.
除了一個人外，大家都出席了。
They decided to make an exception for us.
他們決定為我們做個例外。

items.colloc: formerly known as 原名為 | formerly employed 曾受僱於
items.distinct: previously 先前 | initially 最初
ex: The building was formerly a bank branch.
這棟建築以前是銀行分行。
She was formerly the head of marketing.
她曾擔任過行銷主管。
The company was formerly a small startup.
這家公司從前是一家小型的創業公司。

items.pos: adj. 免費的；空閒的 | v. 解放
items.colloc: free of charge 免費 | free time 空閒時間
items.distinct: vacant 空缺的 | available 可用的
ex: Registration for the seminar is free.
研討會報名是免費的。
Are you free for a meeting tomorrow?
你明天有空開會嗎？
The upgrade is free of charge today.
今天升級是免費的。

items.pos: n. 基金；資金 | v. 資助
items.colloc: mutual fund 共同基金 | raise funds 籌集資金
items.distinct: capital 資本 | budget 預算
ex: The bank will fund the new project.
銀行將資助這項新專案。
They are trying to raise funds for charity.
他們正在嘗試為慈善機構籌款。
The pension fund has grown significantly.
退休基金已經顯著成長。
